correction.original_overclaim: symbolic representatives equal every Pareto plan identity
correction.corrected_claim: symbolic compiler preserves the set of distinct Pareto objective vectors while canonicalizing exact tied plan identities

model_assumptions: candidate cadence K is positive and discrete
peak/ephemeral demand is nondecreasing in K before capacity clamp
pressure indicator is nondecreasing in K

compiler.step_1: group cadences by identical intervention count N(K)
compiler.step_2: choose the smallest K in each intervention class as canonical representative
compiler.step_3: retain larger same-class K values as mechanism-only or exact-tie identities
compiler.step_5: at capacity H, canonical objective frontier is all activated representatives plus the minimum-intervention fallback representative
